title: The Two Luminaries as the Only Gate of Rest
description: The soul under trial finds no resting-gate among the powers of heaven and earth (her defilers), but only in the sun and moon — Divine Truth in its illuminating manifestation and receptive reflection — through which she ascends to the country of her kindred. By correspondence, the Land of Light becomes the final resting-receiver of those luminaries themselves, when their work of choosing forth the Living Soul is complete.
